user.title: Add an SVG floor plan
user.description: Enter the path to an SVG file under the Home Assistant configuration directory. {details}

assign.title: Element {position}: {element_name}
assign.description:
Configure SVG element {element_id} (type: <{tag}>).

Choose which entities from this element's devices to display here. All available entities are selected by default. Set the first five reading positions below to control their order; selected entities not assigned a position follow afterward in the entity list order. Existing text is updated; readings on supported shapes are added as text showing just the values and units. Automatic placement centers readings in room shapes and puts readings for a floor-plan-sized background near its top-left edge.

Choose an entity from the same devices to control this element's color. A temperature entity is selected by default when available; its numeric state is mapped to the color scale. Choose solid color or fade at the edges to neutral gray. The displayed entities and the color entity can differ.

Select “Skip this element” to give it a neutral gray fill or text color. When setup is complete, a configured SVG copy is saved beside the original and stores these choices for reuse. {details}

data.display_entities: Entities to display on this element
data.color_entity: Entity whose value controls the color

device.title: Choose devices for this element
device.description: Element {position}: {element_name} (SVG ID: {element_id}). Choose one or more Home Assistant devices that provide entities for this element. Their sensor and input number entities will be offered on the next step. Leave the device selection empty to give this element a neutral gray color.

error.invalid_path: Enter a relative .svg path inside the Home Assistant configuration directory.
error.file_not_found: The SVG file was not found. Check the path and spelling.
error.file_read_error: The SVG file could not be read. Check the file permissions.
error.file_too_large: The SVG exceeds the 2 MB size limit.
error.malformed_xml: The file is not well-formed XML. Open it in an SVG editor and fix the reported XML error.
error.not_svg: The XML root element is not an SVG document.
error.invalid_metadata: The SVG has invalid Home Assistant metadata. Check entity IDs, element roles, and temperature settings.
error.unsupported_entity: The assigned entity must be a sensor or input number.
error.missing_role_id: Every element with a Home Assistant role must have an SVG ID.
error.missing_role: An entity group must contain an element with the area, value, or glow role.
error.invalid_temperature_range: Temperature thresholds must be numbers in increasing order: minimum, comfort, maximum.
error.invalid_color: Temperature colors must use six-digit hex values, for example #22C55E.
error.duplicate_ids: The SVG contains duplicate element IDs. Make each SVG ID unique.
error.render_failed: The SVG is valid, but Home Assistant could not render it as a PNG. Check the SVG features and bundled renderer logs.
error.no_assignable_elements: The SVG has no supported, identified shapes or text elements to assign. Add IDs to shapes or text in your SVG editor.
error.no_entity_assigned: Assign at least one Home Assistant entity before continuing.
error.entity_or_skip_required: Select an entity, or turn on “Skip this element” to give this SVG element a neutral gray color.
error.color_sensor_required: Choose a color entity, or set the color mode to “Do not color this element”.
error.color_mode_required: Choose solid color or fade, or clear the color sensor.
error.configure_or_skip_required: Choose displayed entities or configure a color entity, or turn on “Skip this element”.
error.display_sensors_need_supported_element: Sensor readings can be displayed on text, rectangle, circle, or ellipse elements.
error.unsupported_display_entity: Displayed entities must be sensors or input numbers.
error.invalid_color_mode: Choose no color, solid color, or fade at the edges to neutral gray.
error.invalid_display_position: Choose an automatic, centered, or corner position for the displayed readings.
error.device_has_no_sensors: The selected devices have no enabled sensor or input number entities to assign. Choose other devices.

abort.already_configured: This SVG file is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_error: The floor plan could not be reconfigured: {details}
